**Daily Devotional**

**June 25**

*5 Not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to his mercy he saved us, by the washing of regeneration, and renewing of the Holy Ghost; 6 Which he shed on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Saviour; (Titus 3:5-6 KJV)*

Our salvation is all by the grace of God, and is not because of anything we have done. We must put our faith in Jesus, and we will be saved by faith in the grace (Ephesians 2:8) He has provided, and not by our own efforts. Regeneration is talking about our spiritual rebirth. You must be born again with a new spirit to be saved (John 3:3). The word “renewing” was translated from the Greek word “ANAKAINOSIS” and it means “renovation”.

We didn’t just get saved, but we got abundantly saved. We actually got saved to the maximum, or the uttermost (Hebrews 7:25). We have been given everything we will ever need when we were saved, and now we need to learn the laws that govern the spiritual things we have, and learn how to get them from the spirit realm into the worldly realm. Most Christians are not aware of what they have in their born again spirits (Ephesians 1:3), but we have all we need for healing, prosperity, joy, peace and all the fruits of the spirit (Galatians 5:22-23). It is a lot easier to use what we have already been given, than to get something we don’t have. Read the Word of God, and learn just what you do have, and use it. It will make your life heaven on earth – praise God.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
